label: Marimba w, the GS variation tone, read out of a module's own recordings
audition_title: libsonare Marimba w vs the module's own recordings
_notes: The GS variation Marimba w sits at program 12, Bank Select MSB 8; `gm_fallback_map.cpp` voices it apart from its capital and this is the reference that patch is fitted against. The grid sits on the source's own lattice - it holds one recording every three semitones from 24 to 96 and nothing between - at six-semitone steps. The span is the capital capture's compass rounded onto that lattice, so the variation and the tone it is a copy of are read over the same register.
_velocities: One, and 100 is a label rather than a measurement: the font records no velocity and the importer refuses a grid asking for more than one layer. `vel_range` and the dynamics it feeds are excused in `dimensions_na` for that reason.
_dry: Nothing played this, so nothing was switched off. What the file holds is the module's own PCM with no effect in front of it, which is what `source_class: module` asks for.
_stimulus: The gate is the recording itself. Every cell of this grid runs 0.79 to 0.93 s and nothing pads one, so 780 ms is the longest window all 7 of them hold.
_realtime: Read rather than played: `import_sf2.py` extracts the recorded frames, so there is no host to settle and no lead-in to strip. `preroll_ms` is 0 because a recording begins at its own first frame.
_timbres: One. The source holds exactly one recording per note of this tone, so there is no second of it to disagree with and this capture cannot move the voice past `voiced` however complete its coverage.
_dimensions: Coverage is read against `toneclass.canonical_dimensions`, which for program 12 is 12 dimensions. The four below are what this source cannot carry, each argued from what the font sets rather than from its being a font. The ladder rulers listed after them are the modal class's exclusions rather than the source's.

dimensions_na.vel_range: the font declares no velocity layers at all - `velRange` is set on none of its zones, so it holds one recording per note at a velocity it does not state. A grid asking for more than one would write that recording into every row of the axis a dynamics fit reads
dimensions_na.stereo: the recordings are mono (`sampleType` 1) and the font sets no `pan`, so the image is absent by construction rather than by voicing
dimensions_na.register: the font sets no `initialAttenuation` anywhere, so the level relation between one note and the next is not in it. Over this grid the peaks span 1.9 dB, which is the headroom each recording was normalised into rather than the instrument's fall across its compass
dimensions_na.damper: a recording ends where it was cut and carries no note-off, so there is no key lift for a release to be read from
dimensions_na.attack_hf_swing: this reference holds one velocity (100) per note, so there is no softest-to-hardest change to measure -- the same fact vel_range is excused for
dimensions_na.partial_tilt: a ladder ruler, which the modal class does not judge on: it compares decay rates fitted in the h5-h8 and h1-h2 bins, so it times a mode only while one sits within the ladder's window. On this reference a measured mode sits on h5-h8 on 4 of 7 rows in the 0.12-1.62 s window, and a model mode a quarter tone off its slot has its rate read off the fundamental's skirt and the floor instead
dimensions_na.balance: a ladder ruler, which the modal class does not judge on: it averages h2-h6 against h1, so it reads a mode only where one coincides with an integer multiple. On this reference a measured mode sits on h2-h6 on 7 of 7 rows in the 0.12-1.62 s window, and a model mode a quarter tone off its slot reads as missing rather than mistuned; `modes` reads every mode where it is
dimensions_na.tnr: a ladder ruler, which the modal class does not judge on: its +/-2 % n*f0 mask files a mode as tone or noise by whether it lands on an integer multiple. On this reference the median row has 2 of its 6 measured modes in the 0.12-1.62 s window off that mask, carrying -37 dB of the measured mode power, and a model mode a few per cent from an integer multiple crosses to the noise side; `modes` prices that as a mistuning

_room: The module is recorded with reverb, chorus, delay and the insertion effect all off, and `import_sf2.py --report` plus its own dryness check measure the imported corpus rather than taking this declaration's word for it.
_identity: Which file and which of its presets answered this timbre lives in the untracked sibling `marimba_wide.local.json`. Everything here is the method; scoring, fitting and diagnosing read `reference/marimba_wide.json`.
